bio: Found inside the boutique hotel of the same name, which in turn takes its name from the nearby Balarés beach, one of the most beautiful and unspoilt beaches on the Costa da Morte. In the restaurant, with its elegant rustic atmosphere, you will find traditional cuisine based on a fixed-price menu and another tasting menu, always using local seasonal produce and modern techniques. Interesting facts: The menu often mentions some of their suppliers, as their motto is ‘Territory & Proximity & Commitment’....
